method.houses: Not calculated: houses need an exact birth time

convention.label: Amanta months · Vikram Samvat (Chaitradi) · Lahiri sidereal
convention.note: Months run new moon to new moon and the year begins at Chaitra Shukla Pratipada (the Drik / Maharashtra-South convention). The Purnimanta month name is shown beside it.

vara.name: Monday
vara.note: Reckoned from sunrise on the birth date. A birth before sunrise would belong to the previous weekday.

uncertainties: Tithi changes during this date (krishna 16 to krishna 17); the exact value needs your birth time.
Nakshatra pada changes during this date; the exact pada needs your birth time.
Yoga changes during this date (Vajra to Siddhi); the exact value needs your birth time.
Karana changes during this date (Kaulava to Gara); the exact value needs your birth time.
notes: Birth time is unknown, so the Panchang is reckoned at local sunrise on your birth date (the traditional udaya reckoning).

limitations: Without an exact birth time the Lagna (ascendant), the twelve houses and planetary house placements are not calculated, and none is assumed.
The Moon stays in one sign on your birth date, so Chandra Rashi is certain, but the Moon's pada and the Vimshottari dasha start point need your birth time.
The Sun changes sign (Sankranti) on your birth date, so Surya Rashi depends on your birth time.
basis: Sidereal (Nirayana) zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsa.
The Sun and Moon were calculated at the start and end of 2025-04-14 at your birthplace (Asia/Kolkata); a sign is stated only if it is the same at both.
